data.title: Cheating in state exams to become criminal offence
data.description: The government is fast-tracking legislation to make cheating in public-sector recruitment exams a criminal offence and blacklist offenders from working for any state agency.

data.title: Thailand outlines UN peace goals
data.description: Thailand will focus on peace, human rights and regional cooperation at the 81st UN General Assembly (UNGA81) while closely monitoring Cambodian-related issues, Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow said yesterday.

data.title: Nan gets nod for new university
data.description: The cabinet yesterday approved a bill to establish Nan University, turning the Nan campus of Rajamangala University of Technology Lanna into an autonomous public university focused on innovation and the province's needs.

data.title: Cabinet endorses strategic plan to combat fuel crisis
data.description: The cabinet yesterday endorsed a strategic plan for the Oil Fuel Fund and a fuel crisis response plan covering 2026-2029 with wider use of biofuels made from domestic raw materials to help cope with volatility in global energy markets.

data.title: US human rights lawyer and former White House counsel back Yim Leak
data.description: International human rights lawyer Jared Genser and Lanny J Davis, a former White House special counsel and adviser to former US presidents Bill Clinton and George W Bush, have joined the legal and advocacy team supporting Cambodian businessman Yim Leak, according to Seiden Law LLP, which serves as Mr Yim's chief global counsel.

data.title: Dam faces threat from invasive fish
data.description: Fisheries officials are stepping up their surveillance of invasive blackchin tilapia at Lam Pao Dam in Kalasin after finding 111 fish over the past three weeks, including 12 egg-bearing females.

data.title: Doraemon series now streaming on Netflix
data.description: Doraemon -- the blue robot cat that comes from the 22nd century -- lands on Netflix, this time as 25-minute short episodes that fans are looking forward to.

data.title: Blossoms by the river
data.description: Yodpiman River Walk teamed up with Awakening to launch Bangkok Flower Festival 2026, which runs until Sunday, offering visitors an opportunity to experience a blend of flowers with art, design, food and workshops in the Pak Klong Talat area.

data.title: Placebo Club Bangkok offers sound therapy for cancer patients
data.description: Placebo Club Bangkok invites cancer patients to join its "Alternative Music Therapy (Sound Healing)" session, which will take place at Hoam Building, Charoen Krung 47/2, on Sept 29 from 2pm to 5pm.

data.title: Long Life Fest focuses on cancer, stroke, heart attacks
data.description: Get to know your body before it's too late during Long Life Fest, which takes place at Sphere Hall, 5th floor of Emsphere, Sukhumvit Road, from Friday to Sunday.

data.title: Double A Receives The Enhanced Singapore Green Labelling Scheme certification
data.description: Double A Receives Internationally Recognised Environmental Certification.

data.title: SLF to recoup defaulted loans more aggressively
data.description: The government has urged the Student Loan Fund (SLF) to step up debt collection from 2.6 million borrowers in default, distinguishing between those unable and unwilling to repay.

data.title: Heavy rain raises downstream flood risk
data.description: Heavy to very heavy rain forecast across much of the country over the next five days is expected to increase flood risks in Bangkok and the central plains, with water levels in parts of Ayutthaya and Ang Thong potentially rising by up to 1.25 metres.

data.title: BJT calls to speed up charter rewrite
data.description: Bhumjaithai Party (BJT) MP Nikorn Chamnong has urged opposition parties to quickly submit their proposed constitutional amendments to parliament, warning that the process of drafting a new charter could take so long that it may not be completed before the next general election.

data.title: Dates set for Queen Mother's cremation
data.description: An official schedule for the royal cremation ceremony of Her Majesty Queen Sirikit The Queen Mother was issued on Tuesday by the Government Public Relations Department (PRD).

data.title: Minister backs DSI boss appointment
data.description: Justice Minister Rutthapon Naowarat has dismissed claims that the appointment of Pol Capt Piya Raksakul as the new director-general of the Department of Special Investigation (DSI) was a reward for his role in the Senate election collusion case.

data.title: Klatham disputes whip exit
data.description: Reports that the Klatham Party would leave the opposition whip and possibly join the Bhumjaithai-led government have created uncertainty over the parliamentary landscape.

data.title: Moldova declares energy, water emergency
data.description: CHISINAU - Moldova's parliament on Tuesday voted to introduce a 60-day state of emergency in the energy and water sectors as the country faces rising fuel prices and a severe drought.

data.title: US refusing to give Sudan's de facto leader visa for UN: diplomatic sources, UN
data.description: KHARTOUM - Washington is refusing to give Sudan's de facto leader Abdel Fattah al-Burhan, a visa to travel to New York to address the UN General Assembly, two diplomatic sources told AFP Tuesday, a moved confirmed by the UN.

data.title: Trump threatens Iran with 'hell' but unveils fresh talks
data.description: UNITED NATIONS (UNITED STATES) - President Donald Trump told the United Nations on Tuesday he was deciding whether to "annihilate" Iran -- before revealing that US and Iranian officials had held talks for the first time in months.

data.title: Trump signs security deal with Greenland, Denmark at UN
data.description: UNITED NATIONS (UNITED STATES) - US President Donald Trump signed a security deal Tuesday with the leaders of Greenland and Denmark, cooling temperatures after his contentious calls to acquire the autonomous Danish territory.

data.title: Macron urges world to choose UN over 'law of the jungle'
data.description: UNITED NATIONS (UNITED STATES) - French President Emmanuel Macron called Tuesday for countries to recommit to international laws and the UN system over a resurgent "law of the jungle."

data.title: Brazil’s Flavio Bolsonaro turns scandal into poll gains
data.description: SAO PAULO - Despite being caught up in an explosive financial scandal that has dominated Brazil’s election campaign, candidate Flavio Bolsonaro has gained ground with less than two weeks to go before the vote.

data.title: UN chief says Big Oil treats atmosphere as ‘open sewer’
data.description: UNITED NATIONS - Major global oil companies are treating the atmosphere like an “open sewer,” the outgoing United Nations chief Antonio Guterres said on Tuesday in a withering attack on the energy industry at the UN’s high-level meeting.

data.title: 11 hurt as teen opens fire outside school in western Turkey
data.description: TURGUTLU, Turkey - A teenager opened fire outside a high school in western Turkey on Tuesday, wounding 11 pupils, before being detained in the country’s third such shooting in six months, officials said.

data.title: Tunisia says summer of 2026 hottest on record
data.description: TUNIS - Tunisia’s summer this year was its hottest on record, the country’s weather authority said on Tuesday, following multiple heatwaves, water shortages and power cuts.

data.title: Questions mount about Trump Jr’s Russian-financed wedding
data.description: WASHINGTON - A Republican US senator has called for Donald Trump Jr to be subpoenaed over a Russian oligarch close to Vladimir Putin helping bankroll lavish celebrations for the president’s son’s wedding.
